description: ICLR 2027's style file iclr2027_conference.sty (commit 46ed6f4, 2026-09-01), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from github.com/ICLR/Master-Template, folder iclr2027. The folder's fancyhdr.sty (v3.2) and natbib.sty are old copies of mirror packages and are not shipped. One column on US letter. \iclrfinalcopy, the style's switch for the camera-ready and arXiv versions, shows the authors instead of 'Anonymous authors'. The template loads times beside the style (\usepackage{iclr2027_conference,times}); it is left to the document, since under XeTeX ptm has no TU shape. The style defines \font\iclrtenhv = phvb at 8pt, a TFM font from the helvetic package, which XeTeX loads.
